project.name: itdi
project.description:
========================================================================= Macro: mkdirsForDiskImagei5os
Purpose: The Macro takes a directory as input and uses it to create all of the directories that the image will need for i5os. =========================================================================

========================================================================= Macro: copyInstallImage
Purpose: The Macro takes a directory as input copies over all of the built install image file to the directory. =========================================================================

========================================================================= Macro: copyInstallImageWindows
Purpose: The Macro takes a directory as input copies over all of the built install image file to the directory. =========================================================================

========================================================================= Macro: copyInstallImagei5os
Purpose: The Macro takes a directory as input copies over all of the built install image file to the directory. Also, copies the needed launchpad files and the needed license files. =========================================================================

========================================================================= Macro: buildTrialTDIInstallImages
Purpose: The Macro will make the ant calls to build the images for the various trial platforms. =========================================================================
